agreements: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational progress only; they never become verified Experience by category alone.
HEARTBEAT, POLL, RETRY, WAIT, RECONNECT, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
Current anti-thrash code does not delay a safety/recovery downshift because it only suppresses selected_n > current_n.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in the current executable; keep it observational and non-authoritative.
formal_mutation_allowed=false; v2.1 cannot mutate P_base, Identity, Personality or Governance.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly marks speed improvement NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved if v2/v2.1 is rejected.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller-supplied rather than evidence-bound; stale secretary state can be presented as fresh and non-bool truthy values are not rejected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope plus trusted authority comparison and strict runtime typing; unbound/stale inputs fail closed.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Consume exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope data and project the authority-required safe state; stale/revoked/cross-scope authority evidence fails closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, observation window, sample count or uncertainty.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty semantics.

disagreements.finding: The anti-thrash gate itself has no hysteresis/deadband: a trusted shift-rate sequence jittering around 0.49/0.50 can alternate HOLD and RELEASE every decision, creating second-order gear-control thrashing.
disagreements.required_change: Use separate enter/exit thresholds or a bounded cooldown/stateful release rule derived from trusted elapsed decisions. Numeric values remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can suppress safe upshift indefinitely and improve apparent shift rate while worsening cycle completion, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
disagreements.required_change: Bound hold/release behavior and require paired non-regression on cycle, closure and recovery metrics.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience depends on event kind plus bool(independently_verified), not exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt; bool('false') evaluates True.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity, trusted verifier receipt, mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and strict bool/structured verification semantics.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe is transient per aggregate call. Same evidence under new IDs, same ID across restarts/polls/rollback, or same ID rebound to different evidence can be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a rollback-resistant accepted-event/evidence-lineage registry: exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate, same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Route both credit classes through one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt authority path; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller-supplied while directly controlling v2 hysteresis and v2.1 anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive current_gear from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state bound to installation/runtime identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage is caller-supplied; self-reporting C_VERIFIED can remove the unverified G4 cap without exact C evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Derive verification_stage from trusted verifier/acceptance receipts bound to exact mission, step, scope, evidence, freshness and revocation state.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline, precommit, uncertainty or non-inferiority protocol exists for the declared speed metrics.
disagreements.required_change: Use matched workload paired baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency; commits and awake time are forbidden evidence.

disagreements.finding: durable_progress_per_wake can improve solely by changing wake/coalescing cadence or eligible-wake definition.
disagreements.required_change: Freeze canonical eligible-wake and scheduler policies and bind numerator/denominator to durable records.

disagreements.finding: verified_closure_per_hour can be gamed by different observation horizons or downtime/verifier-wait censoring.
disagreements.required_change: Precommit identical exposure clock, start/stop, downtime censoring and interrupted-run policies.

disagreements.finding: Fixed baseline-then-candidate order is confounded by cache warming, recovered faults, prior durable state and verifier availability.
disagreements.required_change: Use randomized AB/BA or equivalent crossover from the same sealed starting snapshot.

disagreements.finding: Completed-only speed metrics can improve by deferring/rejecting/timing out the hardest assigned work.
disagreements.required_change: Use intention-to-treat assigned-workload analysis with completion/defer/reject/timeout coverage and common censoring semantics.

statistical_risks: Caller-forged secretary freshness, authority conflict, current gear or verification stage invalidates causal routing and speed comparisons.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have extreme variance and can create false anti-thrash holds.
A single enter threshold at 0.50 without a lower release threshold can itself create HOLD/RELEASE oscillation near the boundary.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle latency, closure throughput or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later wired from policy-created progress back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity and dual credit paths permit longitudinal verified/operational credit inflation.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
durable_progress_per_wake is denominator-sensitive to candidate-dependent wake cadence.
verified_closure_per_hour is sensitive to observation-window and censoring policy.
Paired runs remain biased if treatment order is fixed and runtime state carries over between arms.
Completed-only metrics have survivorship bias when candidate policy can selectively defer difficult work.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001: stale RED/ORANGE cannot affect gear via caller-forged freshness; non-bool freshness/conflict values reject fail-closed.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery plus permissive caller fallback still produces G1.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017: canonical shift-ledger derivation wins over caller recent_shift_rate_ratio.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004: 1/1 and 2/3 cannot trigger production anti-thrash absent preregistered support/uncertainty semantics.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040: feed trusted ratios 0.49,0.50,0.49,0.50... with otherwise identical state; selected gear must not alternate HOLD/RELEASE solely from threshold jitter.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RELEASE-041: after anti-thrash enters, release requires an independently specified lower exit condition/cooldown; no permanent hold and no one-sample release.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005: safe upshift resumes under bounded policy with non-regressed closure/cycle/recovery metrics.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008: same canonical evidence under 10,000 IDs credits once.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 / ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 / POLL-REPLAY-020: exactly-once acceptance survives calls, restart, rollback and repeated polling.
GB21-EVENT-REBIND-021: same event_id with changed kind/evidence/verifier receipt is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact replay is no-op.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero verified credit; non-bool verification flags reject.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 / OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: receipt-less repeated decision calls create zero additional credit.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013: DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never change verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate 5/4/3 scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-FORGE-034: canonical runtime gear wins over forged caller current_gear.
GB21-VERIFICATION-STAGE-FORGE-035: caller C_VERIFIED without exact trusted C receipt retains unverified cap.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015: matched baseline reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
GB21-WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 / RATIO-GAMING-031: freeze eligible-wake policy and reject denominator-only gains.
GB21-TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 / CENSORING-GAMING-033: identical exposure clocks/censoring remove artificial closure-per-hour gains.
GB21-ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 / CARRYOVER-RESET-037: candidate effect survives AB/BA order reversal from sealed matched snapshots.
GB21-ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038 / HARD-TASK-DEFERRAL-GAMING-039: all assigned work stays in denominator and selective deferral cannot manufacture speedup.
release_condition: No formal/code mutation by this review and no C PASS claim.
Secretary and authority inputs are strict-typed, replay-resistant and evidence-bound; actual fresh authority decision is enforced, not merely secretary-neutralized.
current_gear, verification_stage and anti-thrash metrics are derived from canonical trusted state rather than caller declarations.
Anti-thrash uses preregistered sample/window/uncertainty semantics plus stateful enter/exit hysteresis or equivalent bounded release; threshold jitter cannot create HOLD/RELEASE oscillation.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt; event acceptance is durable, replay-resistant and rollback-resistant.
Verified and operational credit have one authoritative receipt path; receipt-less decision calls create zero credit.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only; runtime maintenance remains zero Experience; P_base stays read-only.
5/4/3/1 weights remain heuristic-only and cannot become capability/Trust/Identity/Personality truth or promotion thresholds.

Speedup claim requires sealed matched workloads, frozen wake/exposure/censoring policy, randomized AB/BA or equivalent crossover, intention-to-treat coverage, uncertainty, and equal-or-better verification/risk quality across durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; real_5min_runtime_live remains false absent real authorized always-on evidence.
